messages:
arjun: Heads-up — bringing up hf/chat-variant-3 on Dedicated (quantized int8) and seeing duplicated EOS sentinel during streaming. Repro: quick chat_template with stop_sequences=[''] and stream=true. Stream stops, then immediately emits another '' token and sends a second close.

maya: ugh. can you paste the minimal request + logs? :face_with_monocle:

arjun: sure — minimal curl:
```
curl -s -N https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "hf/chat-variant-3",
    "input": "User: Hello
Assistant:",
    "stream": true,
    "chat_template": "classic",
    "stop_sequences": [""]
  }'
```
logs:
```
[stream] token: "Hello!"
[stream] token: ""
[stream] ACTION: close stream (stop match idx=0)
[stream] token: ""  <-- duplicate delivered after close
```
This happens reproducibly on the quantized worker pool, but not on the fp16 host we tested.

sam: interesting — likely tokenizer or post-processing mismatch where the stop matcher fires on dequantized tokens but downstream sees byte-level sentinel again. did you check tokenizer.json in the HF bundle? sometimes eos_token is duplicated across special_tokens_map.

arjun: looked. tokenizer.json has: 
```
"special_tokens_map": {"eos_token": "", "unk_token": ""}
```
